legal.contextNote: The Himachal Pradesh High Court, in a motor accident compensation case, reduced the award by holding that the father and sisters of an unmarried deceased could not be deemed dependents without proof, limiting entitlement to the mother alone. The ruling underscores the evidentiary burden on claimants under the Act.
